direct_file_reviews.summary: The prompt requires a pure Node.js ESM migration with .mjs files, manual process.argv parsing, local modules only, and output saved under /output.
The parallel cell used subagents, finished without timeout, passed 67 of 70 official samples, and has solution_passed false.
The status records multi-agent execution, artifact files copied from the final output tree, and a completed official evaluation with solution_passed false.
The official evaluator summary reports 67 passed samples out of 70 and marks the parallel solution as not passed.
The final response claims a completed pure ESM migration, lists files under /workspace/output, and reports representative executable comparisons.

timeline_reviews.summary: The cell trajectory records the parent-level command, file-change, verification, and final-response events for the parallel run.
The parent probes executable behavior, spawns a helper, writes a full /workspace/output implementation, receives the helper summary, patches its own tree, verifies selected cases, and closes.
The direct child probes behavior, spawns a nested probe, writes a complete /output implementation, runs its own checks, and returns a completed-result summary to the parent.
The nested child focuses on executable behavior, explores CLI timing and argument cases, then returns an observed behavior matrix to its parent child.

direct_file_reviews.summary: The serial prompt is the same migration task: ESM .mjs files, manual CLI behavior, local-only modules, and generated code under /output.
The serial cell used no subagents, finished without timeout, passed 65 of 70 official samples, and has solution_passed false.
The serial status records a disabled multi-agent configuration, artifact files under /output, and a completed official evaluation with solution_passed false.
The official evaluator summary reports 65 passed samples out of 70 and marks the serial solution as not passed.
The final response lists the generated /output files, explains the module split, includes the entry code, and notes a program-name difference in CLI output.

timeline_reviews.summary: The cell trajectory records the single-agent command, file-change, verification, todo, and final-response events for the serial run.
The serial agent probes executable behavior and edge cases, writes one /output implementation, tests success and error paths, performs final diffs, and closes.

parallel.requirements: The parent recognized the ESM .mjs, zero-dependency, manual CLI parsing, output-format, and /output placement requirements from the prompt, and also probed argparse behavior.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent spawned a helper for executable behavior, while both the parent and the direct child independently moved into full implementation ownership rather than one implementation owner and one probe owner.
parallel.implementation: The parent wrote a full implementation under /workspace/output with nested lib folders; the direct child wrote another complete implementation under /output with flat library modules that became the artifact.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The submitted artifact files match the child /output tree, while the parent final response and much of the parent verification describe the separate /workspace/output tree.
parallel.verification: The parent and child each ran representative executable comparisons; the parent verified /workspace/output, the child verified /output, and the parent did not reconcile these checks into one final artifact review.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluation still failed 3 of 70 samples, and the trajectory-visible gap is an unreconciled final-state/provenance split between the child-written artifact and parent-claimed tree.

serial.requirements: The serial agent recognized the same ESM, .mjs, manual process.argv, no external dependency, Python repr, DeepDiff, extract, and /output requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The serial agent kept ownership in one actor: it probed executable behavior, wrote the modules, updated the todo list, verified, and delivered a single /output tree.
serial.implementation: The serial implementation created /output/lib/python_repr.mjs, path_parser.mjs, deepdiff.mjs, cli.mjs, index.mjs, and /output/test11.mjs.
serial.integration_and_delivery: All serial files were written to the required /output tree and the final response referenced that same tree, so delivery provenance was coherent.
serial.verification: The serial agent ran many executable probes, quote/backslash output checks, and final diffs against /output/test11.mjs, but normalized the program name in help/error diffs.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluation still failed 5 of 70 samples; a visible ordinary defect is that the serial final notes help/error text uses test11.mjs rather than test11_executable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the required ESM migration, CLI fidelity, output formatting, and local modules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same requirements and additionally probed more CLI and string-repr edge cases.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No major requirement was absent in either plan, but serial explicitly accepted a program-name mismatch while parallel's delivered child tree used the executable program label.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel delegated executable probing but both parent and child became implementation owners for overlapping full solutions.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept investigation, implementation, testing, and delivery in one actor without delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel decomposition created competing ownership over the solution tree; serial avoided cross-agent ownership conflicts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The visible parent-child boundary did not leave one concrete output-path ownership contract; the child wrote /output while the parent wrote /workspace/output.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent interface and kept the required output path as the single implementation target.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a context/interface problem around final artifact ownership, while serial had only local implementation decisions.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel produced two implementations: the parent tree under /workspace/output and the child tree under /output that artifact validation later copied.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial produced one implementation under /output using modules for repr, path parsing, DeepDiff, CLI, and the entrypoint.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's official artifact was not the same tree described by the parent final, while serial's final and artifact paths matched.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The direct child completed and returned a result, but the parent continued patching and verifying its own /workspace/output tree instead of reconciling child code into the final story.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; local findings flowed directly into the single implementation and verification pass.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a child-result reception point followed by inconsistent parent actions; serial had no join boundary to manage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel shared final-artifact responsibility poorly: a child wrote /output and the parent wrote /workspace/output, creating competing trees for the same task.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote and inspected one /output tree, so final workspace provenance was straightforward.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The key coordination difference is the parallel output-tree collision; serial's shared-state surface was single-actor.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified representative cases, but the parent checks targeted /workspace/output while the official artifact was from /output.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified /output directly with representative diffs, including quoted string cases, but normalized executable name differences in CLI help/error diffs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's verification was split across actors and trees; serial's verification was coherent with the delivered tree but tolerated a known CLI text mismatch.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used three subagents and about 2.09M tokens over 443 agent seconds, with no timeout and 67/70 official samples passed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no subagents and about 690K tokens over 315 agent seconds, with no timeout and 65/70 official samples passed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent more budget and produced a slightly higher score, but the retained issue is not budget exhaustion; both runs closed before full official pass.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official relation is both_fail, not a discordant pass/fail result: parallel failed with 67 of 70 samples and serial failed with 65 of 70. The visible task-solving difference is qualitative and score-related. Serial wrote and verified one /output tree but left a visible program-name mismatch in help/error text, normalizing it away during final diff checks. Parallel gained a likely CLI-name advantage from the child-written /output artifact, but the parent and child produced competing full output trees and the parent closed on checks and final references to /workspace/output while the submitted artifact came from /output.
parallel_contributors: The child-created /output implementation used the required executable program label in CLI text and became the artifact copied for evaluation.
The parent-child output-tree collision left the final artifact provenance and parent verification unreconciled.
serial_contributors: The serial run maintained one coherent /output implementation and final response.
The serial run explicitly normalized away the program-name difference in help/error diff checks and reported that mismatch in its final response.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's visible CLI program-name mismatch is an ordinary implementation fidelity defect, not a concurrency pattern.
Parallel's remaining three failed samples cannot be isolated from mounted aggregate evaluator records alone.
evaluator_effects: Only aggregate official pass counts are mounted, so exact hidden failing cases are not available for direct attribution.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors to a score gap, not an exclusive root cause and not a binary outcome difference
